title: Lal Singh Chaddha
description: Laal Singh Chaddha, a man with low IQ, experiences life's highs and lows while searching for his childhood love, Rupa, across decades.

title: Dostana
description: Sam and Kunal fake being a gay couple to rent an apartment. Living with Neha, their charming roommate, they both fall for her and compete for her love, only to find she's in love with another man.

title: Bhagam Bhag
description: Champak, a theatre owner, goes to London with Bunty and Babla for a show, but their trip turns chaotic when they get trapped in a murder case they didn't commit.

title: Humpty Sharma Ki Dulhania
description: Kavya, a spirited girl from Ambala, visits Delhi to shop for her wedding to an NRI. There, she meets the fun-loving Humpty Sharma, and their unexpected connection blossoms into true love.

title: Tiger Zinda Hai
description: RAW Agent Tiger teams up with Zoya to rescue nurses trapped by terrorists. Together, they face danger and risk everything to bring the hostages to safety in a daring mission.

title: Soldier
description: After Major Vijay Malhotra's colleagues betray him, he is branded as a traitor and subsequently killed. But his son, Vicky, vows to take revenge on his father's murderers and prove his innocence.

title: Bhoot
description: Swati and Vishal move into a new flat, unaware it's haunted by the spirit of the former tenant. Soon, Vishal grows alarmed as Swati begins acting strangely under the ghost's unsettling influence.

title: Cinebuzz
description: Celebrity interviews, movie reviews, and the latest Bollywood buzz-Cinebuzz brings you the glam and gossip straight from the heart of Indian cinema.

title: Romeo Akbar Walter
description: A bank cashier, Romeo, is recruited by India's intelligence agency for espionage in Pakistan. However, he finds himself in challenging situations when his cover gets blown.

description: Celebrity interviews, movie reviews, and the latest Bollywood buzz-Cinebuzz brings you the glam and gossip straight from the heart of Indian cinema.

title: Mary Kom
description: Mary Kom convinces a coach to train her in boxing. Despite her father's disapproval, she follows her dream and begins a journey of grit, glory, and self-belief.

title: Love Aaj Kal
description: In a tech-driven world, two lovers drift apart. Through heartbreak and distance, they fight to find each other again and rediscover the love they once abandoned.

title: Raja Hindustani
description: Raja, a taxi driver, marries Aarti despite her wealthy family's objections. But her stepmother plots to create misunderstandings between them, threatening their love and happiness.

title: Housefull
description: Aarush, plagued by constant bad luck, hopes to find love and happiness but instead lands in a series of hilarious and chaotic situations that make his already miserable life even more complicated.

title: Dhoom 2
description: Fearless thief Mr A steals priceless artifacts alongside an alluring female partner, while three determined police officers close in on their trail.

title: Raja Shivaji
description: The journey of the young Shivaji, who fought against the powers that be and was crowned as Chhatrapati monarch.
